## About
Valley Collision is an auto body and collision repair shop at 645 E San Bernardino Rd in Covina. When your car has been hit, bring it to us and we'll work to get it looking right again.
One longtime customer told us she trusts us with her auto body needs and keeps coming back. Another reviewer said we restored his Mazda and it looked like a new car again. Customers have mentioned Danny, Angel and John by name, and we're glad to be the shop people come back to.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repair work for cars that have been in an accident, from bodywork to getting the finish looking right.

## FAQ
Q: What is the shop phone number?
A: You can call us at 626.915.6800.

Q: Can I get a car to drive while mine is being repaired?
A: One reviewer said we let him use a car while his was being worked on. Give us a call to ask about your repair.
